title: Nango-neo DTformats.neo.v5.17
description: Canonical dictionary format v5.17. All defined word and meaning fields are required; unknown or inapplicable string values use an empty string and list values use an empty array. Adds meaning-level antonyms and similar-word distinctions.

words.description: Dictionary keyed by the display word. The key is the word itself, not a word/any field.

pronunciation.description: Pronunciation transcription such as IPA. Store independently from word and reading.

category.description: Compatibility field containing the first classification tag. Prefer categoryTags for new records.

eraTag.description: One era/time-period tag for the word. Not a linguistic classification or meaning-level domain tag.

reading.description: Japanese reading stored separately; do not append it to the display word in parentheses.

other_tags.description: Hashtag-style related labels displayed on the word entry. Do not use as substitutes for categoryTags, fieldTag or eraTag.

categoryTags.description: Classification tags based on the linguistic/type nature of the word, not the domains in which a specific meaning is used. Maximum 3 tags per word.

word.description: A word entry. The word key is the headword only; reading belongs in reading, and original foreign spelling belongs in english.

fieldTag.description: Array of meaning-level domain/use-context tags, maximum 2 per meaning. Each tag is a separate item. These describe where/how this specific meaning is used, not what kind of word it is.

antonyms.description: Meaning-level antonyms or clearly contrasting words. Use an empty array when none is known or applicable.

similarWordsDifference.description: A concise but informative comparison with similar expressions, explaining differences in meaning, usage, register, nuance or context. Use an empty string when no reliable distinction can be stated.
